description: A holding pen for the studio's guests dressed up as a foyer: bolted-down bucket seats, a carpet worn to grey tramlines toward one door, and a wall of muted monitors showing the stage feed on a three-second delay. A page in a KSAB blazer works the turnstile, scanning tickets with a wand that beeps if it feels like it. A sign warns APPLAUSE IS MANDATORY. THE HOUSE IS MIKED.
name: KSAB Audience Lobby
